verdicts.reason: Both are almost the same layout: the headline is big on the left, and 'Now in four flavours' sits in a narrow right column above a tiny CTA. In both, the 'See the Flavours' button has shrunk to near-unreadable text and is jammed against the period of 'sunshine.', and the two-line subcopy is squeezed into a cramped column. B's right column sits a few pixels closer to the headline's vertical centre, while A's subcopy rides slightly higher. The difference is too small to call a winner.
